epics.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Cycle Findings
epics.jtbd: When a self-falsification audit identifies unresolved findings, I want the root causes to be fixed directly, so that the container starts and the CI pipeline passes without inventing adjacent scope.
requirements: R1: Fix HTTP 401 errors on EmployeeDossier endpoints by properly implementing Moodle SSO integration.
R2: Dynamically determine matching pages in DocumentController.java (searchDocuments) instead of returning hardcoded List.of(1).

slices.title: Fix EmployeeDossier SSO and DocumentController stubs
slices.jtbd: When implementing backend fixes for this epic, I want to resolve the missing SSO integration and the hardcoded search stub, so that the self-falsification findings are addressed and the codebase meets the original specification.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authorized user, When they access the EmployeeDossier endpoints, Then the system uses Moodle SSO integration and returns 200/201 without HTTP 401 errors.
Given a document search request, When the user searches for documents, Then the returned matched_pages are dynamically determined based on actual search matching instead of a hardcoded list.
